response.query: What pilot-scaling stop/go rules tied to parameter recovery (bias/SE for slopes/thresholds) and sample sizes (N values) will determine whether to expand to multi-site rollout?
response.answer: Pilot-scaling stop/go rules depend on parameter recovery accuracy and sample size validation; multi-site rollout expansion hinges on achieving statistically significant bias/SE for slopes/thresholds and adequate N values.
